column5: \cellcolor{eTASPurple}\textcolor{white}{\textbf{Description}}
\cellcolor{eTASGray30} This interface provides the SrvcMgr module with the information needed to enable its functionalities.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to read the battery voltage sensor availability status from SUSD to determine when DTC U19A6 57 check can be performed in RUN mode.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to allow the SUSD to initiate the shutdown procedure.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30} SrvcMgr module will read the value of Learning Table Status using this interface.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30} SrvcMgr retrieve the list of the required services expected to be learnt but were not found/discovered using this interface.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30} SrvcMgr retrieve the list of required subscriptions that were expected to be sent and acknowledged but they were not acknowledged using this interface.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface for triggering learning session.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30} SrvcMgr module will retrieve information about the Learning Table content.

\cellcolor{eTASGray30} This interface provides SrvcMgr module with the capability to calibrate off services or service groups. This interface is intended to communicate SrvcMgr (client) with external SWCs (server) providing the operation surveyServiceDisableCalibrations to be implemented by ECU integrators.

\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SPM module uses this interface to set the state of a list of services. Grouped services are routed to Sd_ServiceGroupStart /Stop, while non-group services use Sd_Client/ServerService\\SetState with consumed-event propagation for requested client services (through the common activation helper).
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}Associated to this interface there are two operations SrvcMgr_DisableService and SrvcMgr_DisableService- Group that will be called by SWCs.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to notify the latest status of U19A6 54 DTC.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to notify the latest status of U19A6 57 DTC.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to receive the service 0x14 DTC clear confirmation to execute U19A6 57 DTC logic.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to read the Propulsion System Active signal for RID 0x0612 enable condition checking.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to receive the Dtc Value for a specific Service ID.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to read Vehicle Speed Average Driven for RID 0x0612 and RID 0x0654 enable condition checking.

\cellcolor{eTASGray30}This interface is introduced in case of reference to the same service-based signals of Propulsion System Active signal and Vehicle Speed Average Driven for RID 0x0612 and RID 0x0654 enable condition checking.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}The SrvcMgr module uses this interface to notify the status of the Learning Table.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}SrvcMgr shall keep track of the serviceIds coming from SSFM in a separate buffer if these services are not available in the SD list via Sd_Retrieve api.
\cellcolor{eTASGray30}SrvcMgr modules uses this interface to provide the learning status to the SPM when RID 0x654 is triggered and completed.
